extraSlicesNotCounted.purpose: test-run permission annotation, approve endpoint state check, resume call

issues.title: test-run executes HIGH tools under admin:ai:tool:edit, bypassing approval permission and approval record
issues.impact: Holder of tool-edit can execute arbitrary registered HIGH tools (declarative HTTP writes, SQL, MCP writes) with approved=true, userId=null, no ai_tool_call audit row.
issues.recommendation: Require admin:ai:tool:approve (at least for HIGH) and write an auditable record with operator and argument digest.

issues.title: test-run ignores tool status, clientTypes and permissionCodes floor
issues.impact: DISABLED tools, client-scoped tools and tools declaring permission codes are all executable by test-run; the invoke-time floor is skipped.
issues.recommendation: Reuse resolveEffective filters or reject non-ENABLED tools; require the operator to hold declared permission codes.

issues.title: approve TOCTOU allows duplicate execution of the same HIGH tool
issues.impact: Concurrent approvals both pass the WAITING_APPROVAL check; the side effect runs twice.
issues.recommendation: Conditional UPDATE ... WHERE status='WAITING_APPROVAL' and use affected rows as the execution permit, or add a version column.

issues.title: approval result is never fed back into the conversation; resume restarts from the model round
issues.impact: Model never sees the executed result and may re-request the same tool, looping approvals or answering on a false premise.
issues.recommendation: Append a TOOL result message with the toolCallId before resume, or resume with the executed outcome as input.

issues.title: USER_CONFIRM has no requester-facing path; it collapses to admin approval
issues.impact: A tool configured for user confirmation still requires admin:ai:tool:approve; the requester cannot confirm their own action. Three policy values behave as two.
issues.recommendation: Add an app-side self-confirm endpoint validating request.getUserId(), or disable USER_CONFIRM in the editor and document the reduced semantics.

issues.title: syncFromCode never re-syncs approvalPolicy for existing code tools
issues.impact: A code-declared approval strengthening (NONE -> USER_CONFIRM/ADMIN_CONFIRM) is silently dropped for existing rows on non-HIGH tools, leaving auto-execution.
issues.recommendation: Merge approval policy upward (NONE < USER_CONFIRM < ADMIN_CONFIRM) for existing rows and add a regression.

issues.title: binding approvalPolicy has no enum/floor validation and is applied verbatim
issues.impact: A binding can clear ADMIN_CONFIRM on DRAFT/READ tools (HIGH remains forced by the orchestrator); invalid strings silently force approval.
issues.recommendation: Validate against ApprovalPolicy.all() plus the HIGH floor, and forbid binding policy weaker than tool policy.

issues.title: quota reserve sits outside try/finally; a usage-reserve failure leaks the quota reservation
issues.impact: Repeated failures consume user quota with no compensating release.
issues.recommendation: Track completed reservation steps and compensate in finally, or make reserve idempotent with a single release.

issues.title: fixed pool with unbounded queue and no admission control; quota is charged only when a worker starts
issues.impact: Unbounded queueing of requests (each with DB rows) without quota or rate limiting; shutdownNow cannot drain queued tasks.
issues.recommendation: Bounded queue with an explicit rejection path and pre-enqueue quota/rate checks.

issues.title: first approval-required call aborts the whole batch; later tool calls are dropped silently
issues.impact: Remaining calls get no record, no execution and no tool message; resume may re-generate different arguments.
issues.recommendation: Persist the remaining calls as PLANNED/SKIPPED and replay them on resume.

issues.title: approvalStatus column mixes policy values with call-status values
issues.impact: Queries and UI on approvalStatus conflate confirmation policy with rejection state.

issues.title: raw tool exception text reaches user-visible content, events and the model
issues.impact: Executor/provider internals (SQL fragments, JDBC/URL, upstream body) can be surfaced to app users and stored; safe() only truncates to 500 chars.
issues.recommendation: Return stable error codes/generic text externally; keep detail in logs only.

issues.title: parseAnswer receives but never uses responseSchemaSnapshot
issues.impact: The frozen response schema is decorative; conformance depends only on the prompt.

issues.title: public resume has no state/ownership guard; repeat calls re-finalize and re-settle
issues.impact: Resuming a SUCCEEDED request duplicates model calls, completion events and settlement.
issues.recommendation: Require WAITING_APPROVAL (or a pending-call state) inside resume.

issues.title: test-run silently downgrades malformed JSON arguments to {}
issues.impact: A typo executes the tool with default/empty arguments instead of failing.
issues.recommendation: Use strict parsing and return a parameter error.

issues.title: invoke swallows handler stack traces; AiException branch logs nothing
issues.impact: Tool failures are unactionable in logs.

issues.title: declarative save does not validate the permission CSV; tool can be saved permanently unusable
issues.impact: Malformed codes are accepted at save and fail closed at invoke, with no save-time error.
issues.recommendation: Validate with splitPermissionCsv at save time.

issues.title: AiJson.write returns null on serialization failure, silently emptying audit fields
issues.impact: result_json/blocks_json/input_snapshot can be null with no log, leaving audit gaps.
